summary: AAP 2.6 offers centralized Redis in standalone and clustered topologies; Redis HA needs 6 VMs, can't sit on controller, execution or DB nodes, and external Redis is unsupported for RPM. EDA 2.4 databases are incompatible with 2.6, so remove the EDA 2.4 database before upgrading from 2.4.
questions: Does AAP 2.6 RPM support external Redis?
How many VMs do I need for Redis HA in AAP 2.6?
Why must I remove the EDA 2.4 database before upgrading?
